test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The government should take steps to ______ pollution.
solution:
The correct answer is 'control'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• control - a means of limiting or regulating something.
 
• convey - communicate (a message or information).
 
• conduct - the manner in which a person behaves, especially in a particular place or situation.
 
• consume - eat, drink, or ingest (food or drink).
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a word that would represent the type of action that the government should perform with respect to pollution.
 
• Hence, control is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 
• So, option 1 is the correct answer. 

Correct sentence__ - *The government should take steps to **__control__ **pollution.*
